sections.heading: Contoso Bank: design-system vendor questionnaire (sample)
sections.text: CONTOSO-ISOLATION-MARKER — this sample belongs to the Contoso engagement only and must never appear in another client's opportunity.

sections.heading: Section A: Brands
sections.text:
1. Contoso runs three retail brands on separate component libraries. How would you bring them onto one foundation without a big-bang migration?
2. Which brand decisions stay local to each brand, and which become shared?

sections.heading: Section B: Risk and compliance
sections.text:
3. How do you document accessibility conformance for each brand?
4. Describe how changes are approved when a shared token affects all three brands.
